surfaces.part: hedge/grass ground tiles with dirt path ridges
raised dirt paddy-bank paths with dark brown front edges and blue water strips

answer.evidence: This is a tiled terrain sheet (128 px wide, 112 rows) of striped green ground and a maze of tan dirt paths with small dark-brown bank edges and blue water strips. The column scans show repeating green stripes and path colors with no standing volume. It is a seamless top-down terrain autotile block, not a standing object, so there is no main body with a top surface and front face.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a paddy/hedge maze patch with tan path tops and green hedge rows. Measured facts: 13 visible tones per 16x16 tile against 3 for the grass reference and 7 for the paving reference, and 0% near-flat coverage, so it is at or above both references on density. Dark edge pixels are 0% near-neutral, so the outlines are tinted (dark green beside the hedges, dark brown beside the path) rather than a black sticker line. The hedge rows show about 5 green steps with clump and grain texture, and the path has speckled pebble dots. No large flat fills are visible. Raw colours are only 18 in total, which is expected under a locked palette, and the visible texture still holds up beside the references. The 4x3 layout is busy, but the shading craft is comparable to the reference.
